title: CN Tower with Overcast Sky
coreRelationships: The CN Tower structure is the central and dominant element, occupying the left and center of the frame.
The overcast sky serves as a stark, moody backdrop, emphasizing the tower's silhouette and scale.
The small human figure provides a crucial sense of scale and a point of interest on the vast structure.
The architectural details of the tower, such as the ribbed metal and glass windows, create texture and visual interest.
reuseFormula: Generate a low-angle, medium shot of the CN Tower's upper sections, including the observation deck and revolving restaurant, against a dark, heavily overcast sky. A small, indistinct human figure should be seated on the uppermost platform. The color palette must be dominated by cool greys and whites, with minimal, muted red accents. If typography is required, it should be a small, white, bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif text on a black rectangular background with a white border, placed at the bottom center.
